current_root_design.fixed_scope_note: Twenty-five selected parameters retain the preceding retention-site draws exactly. Reverse-carbonation factor is fixed at one, with permeability, pore radius, condensation factor, evaporation A/E and staged atmosphere also fixed. No reverse-kinetics or atmosphere-range robustness follows. Eight paired samples and unqualified physical/process cases yield exploratory rankings only; no measured material or qualified-process optimization. The ordered-structure viscosity barrier is fixed at 80000 J/mol; the same preceding 25 paired draws are retained. This does not establish robustness across the additional barrier range or identify that parameter. The dry-fraction modulus exponent is fixed at two; its range and correlation with reference modulus are not covered or identified. The matrix phase eigenstrain amplitude is fixed at 0.02; its signed range and correlation with phase kinetics or stiffness are not covered or identified. The coupled algebraic zero-relaxation limit is outside scope. Phase modulus contrast is fixed at four; neither its range nor its correlation with eigenstrain, porosity stiffness or phase kinetics is covered or identified. Disordered-minus-ordered heat capacity contrast is fixed at 10 J/mol/K; its range and correlations are neither covered nor identified. Phase conductivity contrast is fixed at two; its signed range and correlations with phase kinetics, baseline conductivity, moisture and pore radiation are not covered or identified. Tortuosity porosity exponent is fixed at one; its range and correlation with diffusivity, initial tortuosity, liquid occupancy and permeability are not covered or identified. Six positive gas-pair mobility factors are fixed at their declared nominal values; their ranges and correlations with the common diffusivity, tortuosity and permeability are not covered or identified. P20 pure viscosity source coefficient groups and Wilke mixing fraction are fixed; source uncertainty and real mixture/pore errors are not sampled or identified. Historical four assumed species factors were removed, not silently retained as active parameters. P16 four-gas plus calcite/lime source-caloric coefficient sets (30 coefficients) are fixed together; their source uncertainty and correlations are not sampled or identified. Four remaining non-quartz dry background Cp slopes are fixed; ranges and correlations with kinetics, thermal and phase properties are not covered or identified. Liquid-water background Cp slope is fixed at 0.01 J/mol/K2; its range and correlation with retention, phase exchange and heat transfer are not covered or identified. The intrinsic dry-solid conductivity temperature exponent is also fixed; its declared range and correlation are not sampled or identified. Final-model refresh: carbonate phase resistance and pore-scale gas-pair resistance are explicitly fixed at their nominal values of one. Their ranges and correlations are not sampled or identified. Reuse the same 25-dimensional paired draws and three schedules; nominal permeability remains 3.75e-14 m2. Current-run results must be recorded separately from earlier ensembles; process and physical failures remain explicit.
